faq.title: 常見問題
faq.2.q: 收集的東西存在哪裡？
會上傳嗎？
faq.4.q: 手機可以用嗎？
faq.5.q: 要搭配哪一個 AI？
faq.6.q: 同一頁存兩次，
會變成兩份嗎？
faq.1.a: 免費。沒有付費版、沒有廣告。
faq.2.a: 存在你自己挑的資料夾。
沒有伺服器，
作者收不到任何資料。
faq.3.a: 閒置一陣子之後，
Chrome 會把資料夾鎖起來，
這樣擴充碰不到你的檔案。
下次要存時按一下解鎖就好 ——
那是保護，不是故障。
faq.4.a: 不行。手機上的 Chrome
不能裝擴充，
要在電腦上的 Chrome 用。
faq.5.a: 任何讀得到你電腦上資料夾的
AI agent 都可以，
例如 Claude Code、Codex、
Gemini CLI。
faq.6.a: 不會。同一頁再存一次，
是更新原本那一份；
內容沒變就只會說「已存過」。
faq.7.a: 按側邊欄頂部的聽診器圖示
（遇到問題），
它會當場檢查一遍，
告訴你哪裡壞了、該按哪一顆。
也可以把檢查結果
組成一封信寄給作者 ——
寄不寄由你。

場域數位化、
小公司放大術與產品創作。

faq.1.a: 免費。沒有付費版、沒有廣告。

例如 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI。

內容沒變就只會說「已存過」。

它會當場檢查一遍，告訴你哪裡壞了、該按哪一顆。
也可以把檢查結果組成一封信寄給作者 ——
寄不寄由你。

changelog.title: Release notes
faq.title: Questions
and answers
faq.2.q: Where is everything
saved?
Is it uploaded?
faq.4.q: Can I use it
on my phone?
faq.5.q: Which AI
does it work with?
faq.6.q: If I save the same page
twice,
do I get two copies?
faq.1.a: No, it’s free.
There’s no paid version
and no ads.
faq.2.a: In a folder you choose yourself.
There’s no server,
so the author never
receives any of it.
faq.3.a: After a while idle,
Chrome locks the folder
so the extension can’t
touch your files.
Next time you save,
click “Unlock folder”.
That’s the protection working,
not a bug.
faq.4.a: No. Chrome on phones
can’t install extensions, so use it
in Chrome on your computer.
faq.5.a: Any AI agent
that can read a folder
on your computer,
such as Claude Code, Codex
or Gemini CLI.
faq.6.a: No. Saving the same page again
updates the copy
you already have;
if nothing changed,
it just says “Already saved”.
faq.7.a: Click the stethoscope icon
(“Get help”) at the top
of the side panel.
It checks everything on the spot
and tells you what’s wrong
and which button to press.
It can also put the results
into an email to the author.
Whether to send it is up to you.
author.name: Jerromy
author.bio.1: In the age of AI,
I care about more than
efficiency:
I care about how people use
technology
to find new missions,
new doorways
and new connections.
author.bio.2: I write about AI,
interactive experiences,
bringing physical spaces online,
helping small companies
punch above their weight,
and making products.
foot.line: Turn the web into
material your AI can read.
foot.analytics: This website counts visits
with GoatCounter, with no cookies
and no personal data.
The extension itself
has no tracking at all.
